scope: complete PLAN route-one and route-two distribution requirements using existing observations only
steps: every actually executed step, separated by start and time
continuous_quality: ridge on full k-dimensional residual coordinates; include intermediate outcomes; coefficients/normalization exploration P0 only
mode_analysis: independent paired fits at t0 by final failed branch mode (collision, offroad, TTC, progress); cross-mode heldout evaluation and principal-angle comparison
full_dim_stats: final-quality high/fail mean and variance differences, paired distance and cosine
uncertainty: session bootstrap500; cluster pair sign permutation1999; BH separately across primary k8 all-time route tests and t0 mode-transfer tests; sensitivity dimensions descriptive
shared_hist_bins: 32 quantile bins fitted on exploration P0 projected values; endpoints extended to +/-infinity
insufficient_contrasts: record explicit unavailable/low-coverage status; do not inherit initialization labels or manufacture contrasts
